name: fig15_hawking_spectra
caption: (a) Bose-Einstein and Fermi-Dirac occupation as functions of x = hbar omega/(k_B T_H). (b) Photon-only blackbody spectra with the horizon area for three masses; the peak sits near x = 2.82 (Wien, in terms of dP/domega) and moves to lower energy as M grows. A thermal curve illustrates the spectrum; it is not a derivation of Hawking radiation (see docs/hawking_radiation.md), and greybody factors (Figs 18-20) modify it.
